text: I think you might enjoy this Ww Strawberry Omelet recipe, given your past preference for recipes featuring eggs. Although this recipe doesn't include beef or cheese, it's a quick and relatively low-calorie option that should fit within your typical time budget. The addition of strawberries adds a sweet twist to a classic omelette, which might be a nice change of pace. With only 15 minutes of preparation time, it's a great option for a quick and easy meal.
